fees_override._basis: Portal states a per-semester figure only. Total is per-sem x 4 semesters over 2 years. Portal does not state a lump-sum price, an application fee, or an EMI figure, so those are null.
fees_override._discrepancy_note: Third-party aggregator pages claim a Rs 99,000 lump-sum price. That figure does not appear on the official portal and is NOT to be published. lib/data.ts already carries Rs 1,50,000 for MBA, which matches the portal exactly.

mba_specialisations_from_portal: Forensic Accounting and Corporate Fraud Investigation
unique_angles_to_prioritise: Pharmaceutical Management backed by a real NIRF Pharmacy #41 rank. Parul is a pharmacy-strong institution, so this one specialisation has institutional substance behind it rather than being a marketing label. GSC already shows /mba/pharmaceutical-management at 778 impressions and 0.9% CTR, the best-performing Parul page.

The NIRF category trap. Parul markets 'NIRF Top 50 Innovation' and has a verified Pharmacy #41, but has no Management rank at all. Competitor pages cite 'NIRF ranked' without the category. Show the reader how to read a NIRF claim.
Forensic Accounting and Corporate Fraud Investigation is a genuinely rare online MBA specialisation in India, and Parul's page for it already converts at 2.39% CTR.
Per-semester pricing vs total cost. The portal quotes Rs 37,500 per semester and never shows the Rs 1,50,000 total, which is how a two-year cost gets under-read at first glance.
Who should NOT apply. No AICTE listing on any online programme, and no NIRF Management rank, so anyone whose employer screens on either should look elsewhere.
_skip_reason: The official portal states no scholarship categories, no campus immersion for online students, and no bundled foundation courses. Writing those sections would require inventing facts.
